#ifndef MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES
#define MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES (64ULL * 1024ULL)
#endif
#ifndef MAK_ARENA_BYTES
#define MAK_ARENA_BYTES (256ULL * 1024ULL * 1024ULL)
#endif
#ifndef MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES
#define MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES MAK_ARENA_BYTES
#endif
#ifndef MAK_ARENA_HARDEN
#define MAK_ARENA_HARDEN 1
#endif
#ifndef MAK_ARENA_ABORT_ON_CORRUPTION
#define MAK_ARENA_ABORT_ON_CORRUPTION 1
#endif
#ifndef MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE
#define MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE 64u
#endif
#ifndef MAK_ARENA_MAX_ALIGN
#define MAK_ARENA_MAX_ALIGN (1ULL << 30)
#endif
#define MAK_IR_HEAP_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x4d414b4845415031)
#define MAK_IR_HEAP_LINK_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x4d414b4c494e4848)
#define MAK_IR_HEAP_TAIL UINT64_C(0x4d414b5441494c48)
struct mak_ir_heap_hdr { uint64_t magic; uint64_t cookie; size_t total; size_t payload_off; size_t size; size_t alignment; };
struct mak_ir_heap_link { uint64_t magic; struct mak_ir_heap_hdr *hdr; };
static inline uint64_t mak_ir_heap_cookie(const struct mak_ir_heap_hdr *h) { uintptr_t x=(uintptr_t)h; return MAK_IR_HEAP_MAGIC ^ (uint64_t)x ^ UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15); }
static inline void mak_ir_heap_fault(const char *reason) { if(MAK_ARENA_ABORT_ON_CORRUPTION) { fprintf(stderr, "[MAK:MEM] heap fault: %s\n", reason); abort(); } }
static inline void *mak_ir_heap_alloc(size_t size, size_t align) {
    if (size == 0) size = 1; if (align == 0) align = _Alignof(max_align_t); if ((align & (align-1)) != 0 || align > MAK_ARENA_MAX_ALIGN) return NULL;
    size_t base=sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr)+sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link); if(base>SIZE_MAX-(align-1)) return NULL; size_t pre=base+(align-1); if(size>SIZE_MAX-pre) return NULL; size_t total=pre+size; if(sizeof(uint64_t)>SIZE_MAX-total) return NULL; total+=sizeof(uint64_t);
    unsigned char *raw=(unsigned char *)malloc(total); if(!raw) return NULL; uintptr_t q=(uintptr_t)raw+sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr)+sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link); uintptr_t mask=(uintptr_t)align-1; if(q>UINTPTR_MAX-mask){free(raw);return NULL;} uintptr_t payload=(q+mask)&~mask; size_t off=(size_t)(payload-(uintptr_t)raw); if(off>total-size-sizeof(uint64_t)-sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link)){free(raw);return NULL;} struct mak_ir_heap_hdr *h=(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr *)(void *)raw; struct mak_ir_heap_link *ln=(struct mak_ir_heap_link *)(void *)(payload-sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link)); memset(h,0,sizeof(*h)); h->magic=MAK_IR_HEAP_MAGIC; h->total=total; h->payload_off=off; h->size=size; h->alignment=align; h->cookie=mak_ir_heap_cookie(h); ln->magic=MAK_IR_HEAP_LINK_MAGIC; ln->hdr=h; uint64_t *tail=(uint64_t *)(void *)(payload+size); *tail=MAK_IR_HEAP_TAIL ^ (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h ^ (uint64_t)size; if(MAK_ARENA_HARDEN) memset((void *)payload,0,size); return (void *)payload;
}
static inline void mak_ir_heap_free(void *ptr) { if(!ptr) return; unsigned char *payload=(unsigned char *)ptr; if((uintptr_t)payload<sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link)){mak_ir_heap_fault("invalid heap pointer");return;} struct mak_ir_heap_link *ln=(struct mak_ir_heap_link *)(void *)(payload-sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link)); if(ln->magic!=MAK_IR_HEAP_LINK_MAGIC || !ln->hdr){mak_ir_heap_fault("invalid heap allocation link");return;} struct mak_ir_heap_hdr *h=ln->hdr; if(h->magic!=MAK_IR_HEAP_MAGIC || h->cookie!=mak_ir_heap_cookie(h) || h->payload_off<sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr)+sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link) || h->payload_off>h->total-h->size-sizeof(uint64_t) || h->alignment==0 || (h->alignment&(h->alignment-1))!=0){mak_ir_heap_fault("invalid heap header");return;} unsigned char *raw=payload-h->payload_off; if(raw!=((unsigned char *)h)){mak_ir_heap_fault("heap base mismatch");return;} uint64_t *tail=(uint64_t *)(void *)(payload+h->size); if(*tail!=(MAK_IR_HEAP_TAIL ^ (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h ^ (uint64_t)h->size)){mak_ir_heap_fault("heap allocation canary corrupted");return;} if(MAK_ARENA_HARDEN) memset(payload,0xdd,h->size); h->magic=0; h->cookie=0; ln->magic=0; free(raw); }
#if MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES < 4096
#error "MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES must be at least 4096"
#endif
#if MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES < MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES
#error "MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES must be >= MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES"
#endif
#if MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE < 1
#error "MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE must be >= 1"
#endif
#define MAK_IR_MEM_PAGE_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x4d414b5041474531)
#define MAK_IR_MEM_HEAD_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x4d414b4845414431)
#define MAK_IR_MEM_LINK_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x4d414b4c494e4b31)
#define MAK_IR_MEM_TAIL_MAGIC UINT64_C(0x4d414b5441494c31)
#define MAK_IR_MEM_LIVE 1u
#define MAK_IR_MEM_FREE 2u
#define MAK_IR_MEM_QUARANTINED 3u
struct mak_ir_mem_page;
struct mak_ir_mem_hdr;
struct mak_ir_mem_link { uint64_t magic; struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *hdr; };
struct mak_ir_mem_hdr {
    uint64_t magic;
    uint64_t cookie;
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *page;
    size_t total;
    size_t payload_offset;
    size_t size;
    size_t capacity;
    size_t alignment;
    uint32_t state;
    uint32_t class_id;
    struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *prev;
    struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *next;
};
struct mak_ir_mem_page {
    uint64_t magic;
    uint64_t cookie;
    size_t capacity;
    size_t used;
    size_t blocks;
    size_t live;
    size_t free_blocks;
    int dedicated;
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *prev;
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *next;
    max_align_t alignment;
    unsigned char data[];
};
static struct mak_ir_mem_page *mak_ir_mem_pages = NULL;
static struct mak_ir_mem_page *mak_ir_mem_current = NULL;
static struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *mak_ir_mem_free_bins[64] = {0};
static struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *mak_ir_mem_quarantine[MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE] = {0};
static size_t mak_ir_mem_q_head = 0;
static size_t mak_ir_mem_q_count = 0;
static size_t mak_ir_mem_committed = 0;
static size_t mak_ir_mem_live_bytes = 0;
static size_t mak_ir_mem_peak_bytes = 0;
static uint64_t mak_ir_mem_faults = 0;
static atomic_flag mak_ir_mem_lock = ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;
static int mak_ir_mem_atexit_registered = 0;
static inline void mak_ir_mem_lock_enter(void) {
    while (atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit(&mak_ir_mem_lock, memory_order_acquire)) { }
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(void) {
    atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&mak_ir_mem_lock, memory_order_release);
}
static inline uint64_t mak_ir_mem_mix(uint64_t x) {
    x ^= x >> 30; x *= UINT64_C(0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9);
    x ^= x >> 27; x *= UINT64_C(0x94d049bb133111eb);
    x ^= x >> 31; return x;
}
static inline uint64_t mak_ir_mem_cookie_for(const void *p) {
    return mak_ir_mem_mix(UINT64_C(0x6d616b2d73656375) ^ (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p ^ (UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) * (uint64_t)sizeof(void *)));
}
static inline size_t mak_ir_mem_class(size_t n) {
    size_t k = 0; size_t x = n ? n : 1;
    while (x > 1 && k < 63) { x = (x + 1) >> 1; ++k; }
    return k;
}
static inline int mak_ir_mem_add_overflow(size_t a, size_t b, size_t *out) {
    if (b > SIZE_MAX - a) return 1;
    *out = a + b; return 0;
}
static inline uintptr_t mak_ir_mem_align_up_uintptr(uintptr_t x, size_t align, int *ok) {
    uintptr_t mask = (uintptr_t)(align - 1);
    if (x > UINTPTR_MAX - mask) { *ok = 0; return 0; }
    *ok = 1; return (x + mask) & ~mask;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_wipe(void *ptr, size_t n, unsigned char byte) {
    volatile unsigned char *p = (volatile unsigned char *)ptr;
    while (n--) *p++ = byte;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_fault(const char *reason) {
    ++mak_ir_mem_faults;
#if MAK_ARENA_ABORT_ON_CORRUPTION
    fprintf(stderr, "[MAK] arena integrity failure: %s\n", reason);
    abort();
#else
    (void)reason;
#endif
}
static inline uint64_t mak_ir_mem_tail(const struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    return mak_ir_mem_mix(h->cookie ^ (uint64_t)h->size ^ UINT64_C(0xa55aa55af00df00d));
}
static inline unsigned char *mak_ir_mem_payload(const struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    return h && h->page ? h->page->data + h->payload_offset : NULL;
}
static inline uint64_t *mak_ir_mem_tail_ptr(const struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    return (uint64_t *)(void *)(mak_ir_mem_payload(h) + h->size);
}
static inline int mak_ir_mem_page_contains(const struct mak_ir_mem_page *p, const void *ptr) {
    if (!p || !ptr) return 0;
    if (p->used > p->capacity) return 0;
    uintptr_t lo = (uintptr_t)(const void *)p->data;
    uintptr_t hi = lo + p->used;
    uintptr_t x = (uintptr_t)ptr;
    return hi >= lo && x >= lo && x < hi;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_unlink_free(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    if (!h) return;
    size_t c = h->class_id < 64u ? (size_t)h->class_id : 63u;
    if (h->prev) h->prev->next = h->next; else mak_ir_mem_free_bins[c] = h->next;
    if (h->next) h->next->prev = h->prev;
    h->prev = NULL; h->next = NULL;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_link_free(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    size_t c = h->class_id < 64u ? (size_t)h->class_id : 63u;
    h->prev = NULL; h->next = mak_ir_mem_free_bins[c];
    if (h->next) h->next->prev = h;
    mak_ir_mem_free_bins[c] = h;
}
static inline int mak_ir_mem_header_valid(const struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    if (!h || h->magic != MAK_IR_MEM_HEAD_MAGIC || !h->page) return 0;
    if (h->cookie != mak_ir_mem_cookie_for(h)) return 0;
    if (h->class_id >= 64u || h->capacity == 0 || h->payload_offset < sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr) + sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link)) return 0;
    if (h->payload_offset > h->page->capacity || h->size > h->page->capacity - h->payload_offset) return 0;
    if (h->alignment == 0 || (h->alignment & (h->alignment - 1)) != 0) return 0;
    if (h->size > h->capacity) return 0;
    return 1;
}
static inline int mak_ir_mem_canary_valid(const struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    if (!mak_ir_mem_header_valid(h)) return 0;
    return *mak_ir_mem_tail_ptr(h) == mak_ir_mem_tail(h);
}
static void mak_ir_mem_reclaim_empty_locked(void) {
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = mak_ir_mem_pages;
    while (p) {
        struct mak_ir_mem_page *next = p->next;
        int clean = 1;
        if (p->magic != MAK_IR_MEM_PAGE_MAGIC || p->used > p->capacity) { p = next; continue; }
        if (p->live == 0 && p->free_blocks == p->blocks) {
            size_t off = 0;
            while (off < p->used) {
                if (p->used - off < sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr)) { clean = 0; break; }
                struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h = (struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *)(void *)(p->data + off);
                if (!mak_ir_mem_header_valid(h) || h->state != MAK_IR_MEM_FREE) { clean = 0; break; }
                mak_ir_mem_unlink_free(h);
                if (h->total == 0 || h->total > p->used - off) { clean = 0; break; }
                off += h->total;
            }
            if (!clean || off != p->used) { p = next; continue; }
            if (p->dedicated || p != mak_ir_mem_current) {
                if (p->prev) p->prev->next = p->next; else mak_ir_mem_pages = p->next;
                if (p->next) p->next->prev = p->prev;
                if (mak_ir_mem_current == p) mak_ir_mem_current = p->prev ? p->prev : p->next;
                if (mak_ir_mem_committed >= sizeof(*p) + p->capacity) mak_ir_mem_committed -= sizeof(*p) + p->capacity; else mak_ir_mem_committed = 0;
                free(p);
            } else {
                p->used = 0; p->blocks = 0; p->live = 0; p->free_blocks = 0;
            }
        }
        p = next;
    }
}
static inline struct mak_ir_mem_page *mak_ir_mem_page_new_locked(size_t cap, int dedicated) {
    size_t bytes;
    if (cap < MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES) cap = MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES;
    if (mak_ir_mem_add_overflow(sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_page), cap, &bytes)) return NULL;
    if (bytes > MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES - (mak_ir_mem_committed < MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES ? mak_ir_mem_committed : MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES)) return NULL;
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = (struct mak_ir_mem_page *)malloc(bytes);
    if (!p) return NULL;
    memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
    p->magic = MAK_IR_MEM_PAGE_MAGIC;
    p->cookie = mak_ir_mem_cookie_for(p);
    p->capacity = cap; p->dedicated = dedicated;
    p->prev = NULL; p->next = mak_ir_mem_pages;
    if (p->next) p->next->prev = p;
    mak_ir_mem_pages = p; mak_ir_mem_current = p;
    mak_ir_mem_committed += bytes;
    if (mak_ir_mem_committed > mak_ir_mem_peak_bytes) mak_ir_mem_peak_bytes = mak_ir_mem_committed;
    return p;
}
static inline struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *mak_ir_mem_find_free_locked(size_t size, size_t align) {
    size_t c0 = mak_ir_mem_class(size);
    for (size_t c = c0; c < 64; ++c) {
        for (struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h = mak_ir_mem_free_bins[c]; h; h = h->next) {
            if (h->state != MAK_IR_MEM_FREE || !mak_ir_mem_header_valid(h)) continue;
            if (!mak_ir_mem_canary_valid(h)) { mak_ir_mem_fault("free-block canary corrupted"); continue; }
            if (h->capacity < size || h->alignment < align) continue;
            return h;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_make_live_locked(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h, size_t size, size_t align) {
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = h->page;
    if (h->state == MAK_IR_MEM_FREE && p->free_blocks) --p->free_blocks;
    h->state = MAK_IR_MEM_LIVE;
    h->size = size;
    h->alignment = h->alignment > align ? h->alignment : align;
    h->class_id = (uint32_t)mak_ir_mem_class(h->capacity);
    *mak_ir_mem_tail_ptr(h) = mak_ir_mem_tail(h);
    if (MAK_ARENA_HARDEN) memset(mak_ir_mem_payload(h), 0, h->capacity);
    ++p->live;
    mak_ir_mem_live_bytes += size;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_quarantine_push_locked(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h) {
    if (mak_ir_mem_q_count == MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE) {
        struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *old = mak_ir_mem_quarantine[mak_ir_mem_q_head];
        mak_ir_mem_q_head = (mak_ir_mem_q_head + 1) % MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE;
        --mak_ir_mem_q_count;
        if (old && old->state == MAK_IR_MEM_QUARANTINED) { old->state = MAK_IR_MEM_FREE; ++old->page->free_blocks; mak_ir_mem_link_free(old); }
    }
    size_t slot = (mak_ir_mem_q_head + mak_ir_mem_q_count) % MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE;
    mak_ir_mem_quarantine[slot] = h;
    ++mak_ir_mem_q_count;
}
static inline void mak_ir_mem_flush_quarantine_locked(size_t count) {
    while (count && mak_ir_mem_q_count) {
        struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h = mak_ir_mem_quarantine[mak_ir_mem_q_head];
        mak_ir_mem_quarantine[mak_ir_mem_q_head] = NULL;
        mak_ir_mem_q_head = (mak_ir_mem_q_head + 1) % MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE;
        --mak_ir_mem_q_count; --count;
        if (h && h->state == MAK_IR_MEM_QUARANTINED) { h->state = MAK_IR_MEM_FREE; ++h->page->free_blocks; mak_ir_mem_link_free(h); }
    }
}
static void mak_ir_arena_shutdown(void);
static inline void mak_ir_arena_register_exit_locked(void) {
    if (!mak_ir_mem_atexit_registered) {
        if (atexit(mak_ir_arena_shutdown) == 0) mak_ir_mem_atexit_registered = 1;
    }
}
static inline void *mak_ir_arena_alloc(size_t size, size_t align) {
    if (size == 0) size = 1;
    if (align == 0) align = _Alignof(max_align_t);
    if ((align & (align - 1)) != 0 || align > MAK_ARENA_MAX_ALIGN) return NULL;
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter();
    mak_ir_arena_register_exit_locked();
    struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *reuse = mak_ir_mem_find_free_locked(size, align);
    if (reuse) {
        mak_ir_mem_unlink_free(reuse);
        mak_ir_mem_make_live_locked(reuse, size, align);
        void *ret = (void *)mak_ir_mem_payload(reuse);
        mak_ir_mem_lock_leave();
        return ret;
    }
    size_t overhead = sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_hdr) + sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link);
    size_t needed = overhead;
    if (align - 1 > SIZE_MAX - needed) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    needed += align - 1;
    if (size > SIZE_MAX - needed) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    needed += size;
    if (sizeof(uint64_t) > SIZE_MAX - needed) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    needed += sizeof(uint64_t);
    size_t page_cap = MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES;
    int dedicated = (needed > MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES / 2u);
    if (dedicated) {
        page_cap = needed;
        if (page_cap < MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES) page_cap = MAK_ARENA_PAGE_BYTES;
    }
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = mak_ir_mem_current;
    if (!dedicated && p && p->magic == MAK_IR_MEM_PAGE_MAGIC) {
        size_t candidate = p->used;
        uintptr_t raw = (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data + candidate + overhead;
        int ok = 1;
        uintptr_t payload = mak_ir_mem_align_up_uintptr(raw, align, &ok);
        if (!ok || payload < (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data) { p = NULL; }
        else {
            uintptr_t page_base = (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data;
            size_t payload_off = (size_t)(payload - page_base);
            size_t end = payload_off;
            if (size > SIZE_MAX - end) p = NULL;
            else { end += size; if (sizeof(uint64_t) > SIZE_MAX - end) p = NULL; else end += sizeof(uint64_t); }
            size_t next_used = end;
            size_t maxa = _Alignof(max_align_t);
            if (maxa > 1 && next_used <= SIZE_MAX - (maxa - 1)) next_used = (next_used + (maxa - 1)) & ~(maxa - 1); else if (maxa > 1) p = NULL;
            if (p && next_used <= p->capacity) {
                size_t off = p->used;
                struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h = (struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *)(void *)(p->data + off);
                memset(h, 0, sizeof(*h));
                h->magic = MAK_IR_MEM_HEAD_MAGIC; h->cookie = mak_ir_mem_cookie_for(h); h->page = p;
                h->total = next_used - off; h->payload_offset = payload_off; h->size = size; h->capacity = size; h->alignment = align; h->state = MAK_IR_MEM_LIVE; h->class_id = (uint32_t)mak_ir_mem_class(h->capacity);
                struct mak_ir_mem_link *ln = (struct mak_ir_mem_link *)(void *)(p->data + payload_off - sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link));
                ln->magic = MAK_IR_MEM_LINK_MAGIC; ln->hdr = h;
                *mak_ir_mem_tail_ptr(h) = mak_ir_mem_tail(h);
                if (MAK_ARENA_HARDEN) memset(mak_ir_mem_payload(h), 0, h->capacity);
                p->used = next_used; ++p->blocks; ++p->live;
                mak_ir_mem_live_bytes += size;
                void *ret = (void *)mak_ir_mem_payload(h);
                mak_ir_mem_lock_leave();
                return ret;
            }
        }
    }
    if (mak_ir_mem_committed > MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES || page_cap > MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES - mak_ir_mem_committed) {
        mak_ir_mem_flush_quarantine_locked(MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE);
        mak_ir_mem_reclaim_empty_locked();
    }
    if (mak_ir_mem_committed > MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES || page_cap > MAK_ARENA_MAX_BYTES - mak_ir_mem_committed) {
        mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL;
    }
    p = mak_ir_mem_page_new_locked(page_cap, dedicated);
    if (!p) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    uintptr_t raw = (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data + overhead;
    int ok = 1;
    uintptr_t payload = mak_ir_mem_align_up_uintptr(raw, align, &ok);
    if (!ok || payload < (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    size_t payload_off = (size_t)(payload - (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data);
    size_t end = payload_off;
    if (size > SIZE_MAX - end) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    end += size; if (sizeof(uint64_t) > SIZE_MAX - end) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; } end += sizeof(uint64_t);
    size_t maxa = _Alignof(max_align_t);
    size_t next_used = (maxa > 1) ? ((end + (maxa - 1)) & ~(maxa - 1)) : end;
    if (next_used > p->capacity) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return NULL; }
    struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h = (struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *)(void *)p->data;
    memset(h, 0, sizeof(*h));
    h->magic = MAK_IR_MEM_HEAD_MAGIC; h->cookie = mak_ir_mem_cookie_for(h); h->page = p;
    h->total = next_used; h->payload_offset = payload_off; h->size = size; h->capacity = size; h->alignment = align; h->state = MAK_IR_MEM_LIVE; h->class_id = (uint32_t)mak_ir_mem_class(h->capacity);
    struct mak_ir_mem_link *ln = (struct mak_ir_mem_link *)(void *)(p->data + payload_off - sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link));
    ln->magic = MAK_IR_MEM_LINK_MAGIC; ln->hdr = h;
    *mak_ir_mem_tail_ptr(h) = mak_ir_mem_tail(h);
    if (MAK_ARENA_HARDEN) memset(mak_ir_mem_payload(h), 0, h->capacity);
    p->used = next_used; ++p->blocks; ++p->live;
    mak_ir_mem_live_bytes += size;
    void *ret = (void *)mak_ir_mem_payload(h);
    mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return ret;
}
static inline void mak_ir_arena_free(void *ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter();
    struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = NULL;
    for (struct mak_ir_mem_page *it = mak_ir_mem_pages; it; it = it->next) {
        if (it->magic == MAK_IR_MEM_PAGE_MAGIC && mak_ir_mem_page_contains(it, ptr)) { p = it; break; }
    }
    if (!p) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("free of non-arena pointer"); return; }
    uintptr_t x = (uintptr_t)ptr;
    uintptr_t base = (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data;
    if (x < base + sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link)) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("invalid arena pointer"); return; }
    struct mak_ir_mem_link *ln = (struct mak_ir_mem_link *)(void *)((unsigned char *)ptr - sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link));
    if (ln->magic != MAK_IR_MEM_LINK_MAGIC || !ln->hdr) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("invalid allocation link"); return; }
    struct mak_ir_mem_hdr *h = ln->hdr;
    if (h->page != p || !mak_ir_mem_header_valid(h) || mak_ir_mem_payload(h) != (unsigned char *)ptr) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("allocation header mismatch"); return; }
    if (h->state != MAK_IR_MEM_LIVE) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("double free or stale free"); return; }
    if (!mak_ir_mem_canary_valid(h)) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("allocation canary corrupted"); return; }
    if (p->live == 0 || mak_ir_mem_live_bytes < h->size) { mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); mak_ir_mem_fault("arena accounting corruption"); return; }
    --p->live;
    mak_ir_mem_live_bytes -= h->size;
    h->state = MAK_IR_MEM_QUARANTINED;
    if (MAK_ARENA_HARDEN) mak_ir_mem_wipe(mak_ir_mem_payload(h), h->capacity, 0xdd);
    mak_ir_mem_quarantine_push_locked(h);
    mak_ir_mem_reclaim_empty_locked();
    mak_ir_mem_lock_leave();
}
static inline void mak_ir_arena_trim(void) {
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter();
    mak_ir_mem_flush_quarantine_locked(MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE);
    mak_ir_mem_reclaim_empty_locked();
    mak_ir_mem_lock_leave();
}
static inline int mak_ir_arena_owns(const void *ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return 0;
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter();
    int result = 0;
    for (struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = mak_ir_mem_pages; p; p = p->next) {
        if (p->magic == MAK_IR_MEM_PAGE_MAGIC && mak_ir_mem_page_contains(p, ptr)) {
            uintptr_t x = (uintptr_t)ptr;
            if (x >= (uintptr_t)(void *)p->data + sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link)) {
                struct mak_ir_mem_link *ln = (struct mak_ir_mem_link *)(void *)((unsigned char *)ptr - sizeof(struct mak_ir_mem_link));
                result = ln->magic == MAK_IR_MEM_LINK_MAGIC && ln->hdr && ln->hdr->page == p && ln->hdr->state == MAK_IR_MEM_LIVE && mak_ir_mem_header_valid(ln->hdr) && mak_ir_mem_canary_valid(ln->hdr);
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return result;
}
static inline size_t mak_ir_arena_live_bytes(void) {
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter(); size_t n = mak_ir_mem_live_bytes; mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return n;
}
static inline size_t mak_ir_arena_committed_bytes(void) {
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter(); size_t n = mak_ir_mem_committed; mak_ir_mem_lock_leave(); return n;
}
static void mak_ir_arena_shutdown(void) {
    mak_ir_mem_lock_enter();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < MAK_ARENA_QUARANTINE; ++i) mak_ir_mem_quarantine[i] = NULL;
    mak_ir_mem_q_head = 0; mak_ir_mem_q_count = 0;
    for (struct mak_ir_mem_page *p = mak_ir_mem_pages; p;) {
        struct mak_ir_mem_page *next = p->next; free(p); p = next;
    }
    mak_ir_mem_pages = NULL; mak_ir_mem_current = NULL; mak_ir_mem_committed = 0; mak_ir_mem_live_bytes = 0;
    mak_ir_mem_peak_bytes = 0;
    memset(mak_ir_mem_free_bins, 0, sizeof mak_ir_mem_free_bins);
    mak_ir_mem_lock_leave();
}

// =====================================================================
// pureprintf.mak
// =====================================================================
// A printf in pure MAK. Uses libc putchar for output; all formatting,
// width/padding, sign handling, base conversion, and float rendering
// are implemented in MAK itself.
//
// Supported directives:
//   %d  %i          signed integer
//   %u              unsigned integer
//   %x  %X          hex, lower / upper
//   %o              octal
//   %b              binary (extension)
//   %c              character
//   %s              NUL-terminated string
//   %p              pointer, formatted as 0x...
//   %f              fixed-point f64 (default precision 6)
//   %%              literal %
//
// Flags:   - (left align), 0 (zero pad), + (force sign), ' ' (space sign)
// Width:   any decimal, e.g. %5d, %-10s, %08x
// Prec:    .N — max length for %s, fractional digits for %f
//
// Note on type inference:
//   The spec-parsing helpers take `fmt` and only use it via `fmt[i]`.
//   MAK's representation inference cannot see through `fmt[i]` alone, so
//   without help it defaults `fmt` to i64 and `direct_index_expr` fails,
//   emitting `mak_ir_fail_u64("invalid index expression")` at every index.
//   Calling `strlen fmt` at the top of each of these helpers forces the
//   analyzer to record `Rep::Ptr` for `fmt`, which makes `fmt[i]` lower
//   to a real `uint8_t` dereference in the emitted C.
// =====================================================================

let extern putchar : i32 -> i32 = "putchar" : (i32) -> i32 {
    from = "<stdio.h>";
    pure = false
};

let extern strlen : u64 = "strlen" : (ptr) -> u64 {
    from = "<string.h>";
    pure = true
};

let extern trunc_c : f64 = "trunc" : (f64) -> f64 {
    from = "<math.h>";
    pure = true
};

let extern round_c : f64 = "round" : (f64) -> f64 {
    from = "<math.h>";
    pure = true
};

let extern fabs_c : f64 = "fabs" : (f64) -> f64 {
    from = "<math.h>";
    pure = true
};

// =====================================================================
// Types
// =====================================================================
type Buf {
    BNil;
    BCons i32 Buf;
};

type FmtArg {
    AInt i64;
    AUint u64;
    AHexLow u64;
    AHexUp u64;
    AOct u64;
    ABin u64;
    ACh i32;
    AStr str;
    APtr ptr;
    AF64 f64;
};

type ArgList {
    ArgsNil;
    ArgsCons FmtArg ArgList;
};

// flags bits: 1 = left-align, 2 = zero-pad, 4 = force-sign, 8 = space-sign
type Spec {
    MkSpec i64 i64 i64 i64;   // flags, width, precision (-1 = unspecified), conv-char
};

type SpecPair {
    MkSpecPair Spec i64;
};

type NumRes {
    MkNumRes i64 i64;
};

// =====================================================================
// Buffer primitives
// =====================================================================
let breverse_go src acc =
    case src of {
        BNil -> acc;
        BCons c rest -> breverse_go rest (BCons c acc)
    };

let breverse b = breverse_go b BNil;

let bcount_go src n =
    case src of {
        BNil -> n;
        BCons _ rest -> bcount_go rest (n + 1)
    };

let bcount b = bcount_go b 0;

let bput b =
    case b of {
        BNil -> 0;
        BCons c rest -> {
            putchar c;
            bput rest
        }
    };

let bconcat a b =
    case a of {
        BNil -> b;
        BCons c rest -> BCons c (bconcat rest b)
    };

let brepeat c k =
    case k <= 0 of {
        1 -> BNil;
        _ -> BCons c (brepeat c (k - 1))
    };

// =====================================================================
// Integer digit conversion
// =====================================================================
let rev_digits_go v base upper acc =
    case v == 0 of {
        1 -> acc;
        _ -> {
            let d = v % base;
            let c = case d < 10 of {
                1 -> 48 + d;
                _ -> case upper of {
                    1 -> 55 + d;   // 'A' + (d - 10)
                    _ -> 87 + d    // 'a' + (d - 10)
                }
            };
            rev_digits_go (v / base) base upper (BCons c acc)
        }
    };

let rev_digits n base upper =
    case n == 0 of {
        1 -> BCons 48 BNil;
        _ -> breverse (rev_digits_go n base upper BNil)
    };

let iabs v = case v < 0 of {
    1 -> 0 - v;
    _ -> v
};

let has_flag flags bit = case flags & bit of {
    0 -> 0;
    _ -> 1
};

let sign_char flags n = case n < 0 of {
    1 -> 45;
    _ -> case has_flag flags 4 of {
        1 -> 43;
        _ -> case has_flag flags 8 of {
            1 -> 32;
            _ -> 0
        }
    }
};

let sign_rev sc = case sc == 0 of {
    1 -> BNil;
    _ -> BCons sc BNil
};

// =====================================================================
// Signed / unsigned integer formatting
// =====================================================================
let int_rev flags width n =
    let digits_rev = rev_digits (iabs n) 10 0;
    let dl = bcount digits_rev;
    let sc = sign_char flags n;
    let sl = case sc == 0 of { 1 -> 0; _ -> 1 };
    let content_len = dl + sl;
    let padding = case width <= content_len of {
        1 -> 0;
        _ -> width - content_len
    };
    let sr = sign_rev sc;
    case has_flag flags 1 of {
        1 -> bconcat (brepeat 32 padding) (bconcat digits_rev sr);
        _ -> case has_flag flags 2 of {
            1 -> bconcat digits_rev (bconcat (brepeat 48 padding) sr);
            _ -> bconcat digits_rev (bconcat sr (brepeat 32 padding))
        }
    };

let uint_rev flags width base upper n =
    let digits_rev = rev_digits n base upper;
    let dl = bcount digits_rev;
    let padding = case width <= dl of {
        1 -> 0;
        _ -> width - dl
    };
    case has_flag flags 1 of {
        1 -> bconcat (brepeat 32 padding) digits_rev;
        _ -> case has_flag flags 2 of {
            1 -> bconcat digits_rev (brepeat 48 padding);
            _ -> bconcat digits_rev (brepeat 32 padding)
        }
    };

// =====================================================================
// String handling
// =====================================================================
let str_rev_go s i acc =
    let _ = strlen s;
    case i < 0 of {
        1 -> acc;
        _ -> str_rev_go s (i - 1) (BCons (s[i]) acc)
    };

let str_rev s prec =
    let n = strlen s;
    let limit = case prec < 0 of {
        1 -> n;
        _ -> case prec < n of {
            1 -> prec;
            _ -> n
        }
    };
    breverse (str_rev_go s (limit - 1) BNil);

let str_fmt flags width prec s =
    let body = str_rev s prec;
    let bl = bcount body;
    let padding = case width <= bl of {
        1 -> 0;
        _ -> width - bl
    };
    case has_flag flags 1 of {
        1 -> bconcat (brepeat 32 padding) body;
        _ -> bconcat body (brepeat 32 padding)
    };

// =====================================================================
// Float formatting
// =====================================================================
let force_i64 x = x + 0;

let ten_to_p_go k acc =
    case k <= 0 of {
        1 -> acc;
        _ -> ten_to_p_go (k - 1) (acc * 10.0)
    };

let ten_to_p p = ten_to_p_go p 1.0;

let f64_abs_rev f p =
    case p <= 0 of {
        1 -> rev_digits (force_i64 (round_c f)) 10 0;
        _ -> {
            let scale = ten_to_p p;
            let f_trunc = trunc_c f;
            let f_frac = (f - f_trunc) * scale;
            let ip = force_i64 f_trunc;
            let fp = force_i64 (round_c f_frac);
            let int_digits_rev = rev_digits ip 10 0;
            let frac_digits_rev = rev_digits fp 10 0;
            let frac_len = bcount frac_digits_rev;
            let extra_zeros = case frac_len >= p of {
                1 -> 0;
                _ -> p - frac_len
            };
            let frac_full = bconcat frac_digits_rev (brepeat 48 extra_zeros);
            bconcat frac_full (bconcat (BCons 46 BNil) int_digits_rev)
        }
    };

let f64_rev flags width prec f =
    let p = case prec < 0 of { 1 -> 6; _ -> prec };
    let body = f64_abs_rev (fabs_c f) p;
    let bl = bcount body;
    let sc = sign_char flags (case f < 0.0 of { 1 -> -1; _ -> 0 });
    let sl = case sc == 0 of { 1 -> 0; _ -> 1 };
    let total_len = bl + sl;
    let padding = case width <= total_len of {
        1 -> 0;
        _ -> width - total_len
    };
    let sr = sign_rev sc;
    case has_flag flags 1 of {
        1 -> bconcat (brepeat 32 padding) (bconcat body sr);
        _ -> case has_flag flags 2 of {
            1 -> bconcat body (bconcat (brepeat 48 padding) sr);
            _ -> bconcat body (bconcat sr (brepeat 32 padding))
        }
    };

// =====================================================================
// Spec parser (acyclic to satisfy type inference)
// =====================================================================
let is_digit c = case c >= 48 of {
    0 -> 0;
    _ -> case c <= 57 of {
        1 -> 1;
        _ -> 0
    }
};

let read_num_go fmt j acc =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    case is_digit (fmt[j]) of {
        1 -> read_num_go fmt (j + 1) (acc * 10 + (fmt[j]) - 48);
        _ -> MkNumRes acc j
    };

let read_num fmt i =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    read_num_go fmt i 0;

let spec_prec_state fmt j acc w =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    case fmt[j] == 46 of {
        1 -> {
            let r = read_num fmt (j + 1);
            case r of {
                MkNumRes v k -> MkSpecPair (MkSpec acc w v (fmt[k])) (k + 1)
            }
        };
        _ -> MkSpecPair (MkSpec acc w (0 - 1) (fmt[j])) (j + 1)
    };

let spec_width_state fmt j acc =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    case is_digit (fmt[j]) of {
        1 -> {
            let r = read_num fmt j;
            case r of {
                MkNumRes v k -> spec_prec_state fmt k acc v
            }
        };
        _ -> spec_prec_state fmt j acc 0
    };

let parse_flags fmt j acc =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    case fmt[j] of {
        45 -> parse_flags fmt (j + 1) (acc | 1);
        48 -> parse_flags fmt (j + 1) (acc | 2);
        43 -> parse_flags fmt (j + 1) (acc | 4);
        32 -> parse_flags fmt (j + 1) (acc | 8);
        _ -> MkNumRes acc j
    };

let parse_spec fmt i =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    let fr = parse_flags fmt i 0;
    case fr of {
        MkNumRes flags j -> spec_width_state fmt j flags
    };

// =====================================================================
// Applying a spec to an argument
// =====================================================================
let apply_dispatch conv flags width prec arg acc =
    case conv of {
        100 -> case arg of {
            AInt n -> bconcat (int_rev flags width n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        105 -> case arg of {
            AInt n -> bconcat (int_rev flags width n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        117 -> case arg of {
            AUint n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 10 0 n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        120 -> case arg of {
            AHexLow n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 16 0 n) acc;
            AUint n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 16 0 n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        88 -> case arg of {
            AHexUp n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 16 1 n) acc;
            AUint n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 16 1 n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        111 -> case arg of {
            AOct n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 8 0 n) acc;
            AUint n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 8 0 n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        98 -> case arg of {
            ABin n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 2 0 n) acc;
            AUint n -> bconcat (uint_rev flags width 2 0 n) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        99 -> case arg of {
            ACh c -> BCons c acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        115 -> case arg of {
            AStr s -> bconcat (str_fmt flags width prec s) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        112 -> case arg of {
            APtr p -> bconcat (bconcat (rev_digits p 16 0) (BCons 120 (BCons 48 BNil))) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        102 -> case arg of {
            AF64 f -> bconcat (f64_rev flags width prec f) acc;
            _ -> acc
        };
        _ -> acc
    };

let apply_spec spec arg acc =
    case spec of {
        MkSpec flags width prec conv -> apply_dispatch conv flags width prec arg acc
    };

// =====================================================================
// Main format loop
// =====================================================================
let format_loop fmt i args acc =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    case fmt[i] of {
        0 -> acc;
        37 -> {
            let sp = parse_spec fmt (i + 1);
            case sp of {
                MkSpecPair spec next_i -> case spec of {
                    MkSpec _ _ _ conv -> case conv == 37 of {
                        1 -> format_loop fmt next_i args (BCons 37 acc);
                        _ -> case args of {
                            ArgsNil -> format_loop fmt next_i args (BCons 63 acc);
                            ArgsCons arg rest ->
                                format_loop fmt next_i rest (apply_spec spec arg acc)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        _ -> format_loop fmt (i + 1) args (BCons (fmt[i]) acc)
    };

// =====================================================================
// Public API
// =====================================================================
let pure_printf fmt args =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    bput (breverse (format_loop fmt 0 args BNil));

let pure_println fmt args =
    let _ = strlen fmt;
    bput (breverse (BCons 10 (format_loop fmt 0 args BNil)));

// =====================================================================
// Demo
// =====================================================================
let main =
    fn () -> {
        pure_println "==================================================" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "  pureprintf.mak — a printf in pure MAK" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "==================================================" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Basic:" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "  name=%s age=%d grade=%c"
            (ArgsCons (AStr "Alice")
            (ArgsCons (AInt 30)
            (ArgsCons (ACh 65) ArgsNil)));
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Widths and flags:" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "  right: [%10d]" (ArgsCons (AInt 42) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  left:  [%-10d]" (ArgsCons (AInt 42) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  zero:  [%010d]" (ArgsCons (AInt 42) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  plus:  [%+d]"   (ArgsCons (AInt 42) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  space: [% d]"   (ArgsCons (AInt 42) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  neg:   [%d]"    (ArgsCons (AInt (0 - 7)) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Bases:" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "  hex:  0x%x" (ArgsCons (AHexLow 3735928559) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  HEX:  0x%X" (ArgsCons (AHexUp 3735928559) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  oct:  %o"   (ArgsCons (AOct 493) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  bin:  %b"   (ArgsCons (ABin 170) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  ptr:  %p"   (ArgsCons (APtr 48879) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Floats:" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "  pi        = %f"     (ArgsCons (AF64 3.14159265358979) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  pi(2)     = %.2f"   (ArgsCons (AF64 3.14159265358979) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  pi(0)     = %.0f"   (ArgsCons (AF64 3.14159265358979) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  -pi(3)    = %.3f"   (ArgsCons (AF64 (0.0 - 3.14159265)) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  width10   = [%10.4f]" (ArgsCons (AF64 2.5) ArgsNil);
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Strings with precision / width:" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "  [%.3s]"  (ArgsCons (AStr "abcdefg") ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  [%10s]"  (ArgsCons (AStr "hi") ArgsNil);
        pure_println "  [%-10s]" (ArgsCons (AStr "hi") ArgsNil);
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Recap: %s has %d items at %p, total %.2f"
            (ArgsCons (AStr "Order #1234")
            (ArgsCons (AInt 5)
            (ArgsCons (APtr 305419896)
            (ArgsCons (AF64 99.95) ArgsNil))));
        pure_println "" ArgsNil;
        pure_println "Done." ArgsNil
    };

main()

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

extern void mak_ir_ext_0(int32_t) __asm__("putchar");

#ifndef MAK_RUNTIME_STRICT
#define MAK_RUNTIME_STRICT 0
#endif
static uint64_t mak_rt_recovery_count = 0;
static inline void mak_ir_recover(const char *reason) {
    (void)reason; ++mak_rt_recovery_count;
#if MAK_RUNTIME_STRICT
    fprintf(stderr, "[MAK] runtime failure: %s\n", reason); abort();
#endif
}
static inline uint64_t mak_ir_fail_u64(const char *reason) { mak_ir_recover(reason); return 0; }


int main(void) {
    int32_t arg_0 = (int32_t)((*((const char *)(uintptr_t)("MAK") + (intptr_t)(INT64_C(0)))));
    mak_ir_ext_0(arg_0);
    int32_t arg_1 = (int32_t)((*((const char *)(uintptr_t)("MAK") + (intptr_t)(INT64_C(1)))));
    mak_ir_ext_0(arg_1);
    int32_t arg_2 = (int32_t)((*((const char *)(uintptr_t)(((const char *)(((const char *)(uintptr_t)("MAK")) + (intptr_t)(INT64_C(2))))) + (intptr_t)(INT64_C(0)))));
    mak_ir_ext_0(arg_2);
    mak_ir_ext_0((int32_t)(INT64_C(10)));
    return 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// py_scientific_calculator_fixed.mak — MAK scientific calculator / REPL
// ============================================================================
// Build:
//   mak calc.mak -cc -O3 -o calc
//
// Then link the generated C with libm:
//   clang calc.c -O3 -lm -o calc
//
// Numeric model:
//   * ordinary numbers are evaluated as IEEE-754 f64
//   * /  is real floating-point division
//   * // is floor/integer-style division
//   * %  is floating remainder (for integers it behaves like integer modulo)
//   * ^  is general real exponentiation
//
// Examples:
//   22/7
//   22//7
//   2^100
//   sqrt(2)
//   sin(pi/2)
//   log10(1000)
//   5!
//   ncr(52,5)
//   2*(3+4)
//
// Angles for trig functions are in radians.
// Use deg(x) / rad(x), or the pi/tau constants.
//
// The calculator intentionally stays source-level MAK: no handwritten C
// evaluator is used for the expression engine.
// ============================================================================

// ---------- C / libm FFI ---------------------------------------------------

let external getchar : () -> i32 = "getchar" : () -> i32 {
    from = "<stdio.h>"
};

// FIX: Changed return type to ! (bottom) and foreign type to void.
// This indicates putchar is called for side effects only.
let external putchar : i32 -> ! = "putchar" : (i32) -> void {
    from = "<stdio.h>"
};

    from = "<stdio.h>"

// ---------- Characters / input ---------------------------------------------

type CharList {
    CNil;
    CCons i32 CharList
};

type LineOut {
    LEof;
    LLine CharList
};

let reverse_chars = fn (xs acc) {
    case xs of {
        CNil -> acc;
        CCons c rest -> reverse_chars rest (CCons c acc)
    }
};

let read_line_tail = fn (acc) {
    case getchar () of {
        c -> case c < 0 of {
            1 -> LLine (reverse_chars acc CNil);
            _ -> case c == 10 of {
                1 -> LLine (reverse_chars acc CNil);
                _ -> read_line_tail (CCons c acc)
            }
        }
    }
};

let read_line = fn () {
    case getchar () of {
        c -> case c < 0 of {
            1 -> LEof;
            _ -> case c == 10 of {
                1 -> LLine CNil;
                _ -> read_line_tail (CCons c CNil)
            }
        }
    }
};

let is_space = fn (c) {
    case c of {
        9 -> 1;
        10 -> 1;
        13 -> 1;
        32 -> 1;
        _ -> 0
    }
};

let skip_space = fn (cs) {
    case cs of {
        CNil -> CNil;
        CCons c rest -> case is_space c of {
            1 -> skip_space rest;
            _ -> cs
        }
    }
};

let emit_char = fn (c) {
    putchar c
};

let emit_text = fn (s) {
    write 1 s (strlen s)
};

let print_f64 = fn (x) {
    printf "%.17g\n" x
};

// ---------- REPL commands --------------------------------------------------

let is_exit = fn (cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CNil -> 0;
        CCons 101 r1 -> case r1 of {
            CCons 120 r2 -> case r2 of {
                CCons 105 r3 -> case r3 of {
                    CCons 116 r4 -> case skip_space r4 of {
                        CNil -> 1;
                        _ -> 0
                    };
                    _ -> 0
                };
                _ -> 0
            };
            _ -> 0
        };
        _ -> 0
    }
};

let is_help = fn (cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CCons 63 r -> case skip_space r of {
            CNil -> 1;
            _ -> 0
        };
        CCons 104 r1 -> case r1 of {
            CCons 101 r2 -> case r2 of {
                CCons 108 r3 -> case r3 of {
                    CCons 112 r4 -> case skip_space r4 of {
                        CNil -> 1;
                        _ -> 0
                    };
                    _ -> 0
                };
                _ -> 0
            };
            _ -> 0
        };
        _ -> 0
    }
};

// ---------- Help -----------------------------------------------------------

let print_help = fn () {
    emit_text "\n=== MAK SCIENTIFIC CALCULATOR ===\n";
    emit_text "Numbers are f64 (double precision). Output uses up to 17 significant digits.\n";
    emit_text "Use radians for trig functions.\n\n";

    emit_text "ARITHMETIC\n";
    emit_text "  a+b       addition\n";
    emit_text "  a-b       subtraction\n";
    emit_text "  a*b       multiplication\n";
    emit_text "  a/b       REAL division\n";
    emit_text "  a//b      FLOOR / INTEGER-STYLE division\n";
    emit_text "  a%b       remainder (fmod)\n";
    emit_text "  a^b       power\n";
    emit_text "  2(3+4), 2pi  implicit multiplication\n";
    emit_text "  ( ... )   grouping\n";
    emit_text "  +x  -x    unary plus/minus\n";
    emit_text "  x!        factorial (gamma(x+1), including non-integer extension)\n";
    emit_text "  x%        percentage when % is at the end of a value\n\n";

    emit_text "CONSTANTS\n";
    emit_text "  pi        3.141592653589793...\n";
    emit_text "  tau       2*pi\n";
    emit_text "  e         Euler's number\n";
    emit_text "  phi       golden ratio\n";
    emit_text "  sqrt2     square root of 2\n";
    emit_text "  ln2       natural log of 2\n";
    emit_text "  ln10      natural log of 10\n";
    emit_text "  log2e     log base 2 of e\n";
    emit_text "  log10e    log base 10 of e\n\n";

    emit_text "BASIC FUNCTIONS\n";
    emit_text "  abs(x) fabs(x)     absolute value\n";
    emit_text "  sqrt(x)            square root\n";
    emit_text "  cbrt(x)            real cube root\n";
    emit_text "  root(x,n)          nth root\n";
    emit_text "  nthroot(x,n)       alias of root\n";
    emit_text "  square(x)          x^2\n";
    emit_text "  cube(x)            x^3\n";
    emit_text "  sign(x)            -1, 0, or +1\n";
    emit_text "  frac(x)            fractional part, x-trunc(x)\n";
    emit_text "  floor(x) ceil(x) trunc(x) round(x)\n";
    emit_text "  min(a,b) max(a,b) clamp(x,lo,hi)\n";
    emit_text "  hypot(x,y)         sqrt(x^2+y^2)\n";
    emit_text "  copysign(a,b)       magnitude of a with sign of b\n";
    emit_text "  fmin fmax fdim      C floating-point min/max/positive-difference\n";
    emit_text "  fma(a,b,c)          correctly-rounded a*b+c (where supported)\n";
    emit_text "  nextafter(a,b)      next representable double from a toward b\n\n";

    emit_text "EXPONENTIALS / LOGS\n";
    emit_text "  erf(x) erfc(x)      error function / complementary error function\n";
    emit_text "  logb(x)             exponent of x in binary scale\n";
    emit_text "  exp(x)              e^x\n";
    emit_text "  exp2(x)            2^x\n";
    emit_text "  expm1(x)           e^x-1, accurate near zero\n";
    emit_text "  log(x) ln(x)       natural logarithm\n";
    emit_text "  log2(x)             base-2 logarithm\n";
    emit_text "  log10(x)            base-10 logarithm\n";
    emit_text "  log1p(x)            ln(1+x), accurate near zero\n";
    emit_text "  pow(x,y)            x^y\n\n";

    emit_text "TRIGONOMETRY — radians\n";
    emit_text "  sin cos tan\n";
    emit_text "  cot(x)=cos(x)/sin(x)\n";
    emit_text "  sec(x)=1/cos(x)\n";
    emit_text "  csc(x)=1/sin(x)\n";
    emit_text "  asin acos atan      inverse trig, result in radians\n";
    emit_text "  atan2(y,x)          quadrant-aware angle\n";
    emit_text "  acot asec acsc      inverse cot/sec/csc\n\n";

    emit_text "HYPERBOLIC\n";
    emit_text "  sinh cosh tanh\n";
    emit_text "  csch sech coth     reciprocal hyperbolic functions\n";
    emit_text "  asinh acosh atanh\n\n";

    emit_text "ANGLE CONVERSION\n";
    emit_text "  deg(x)              radians -> degrees\n";
    emit_text "  degrees(x)          alias\n";
    emit_text "  rad(x)              degrees -> radians\n";
    emit_text "  radians(x)          alias\n";
    emit_text "  Example: sin(rad(30)) = 0.5\n\n";

    emit_text "NUMBER THEORY / COMBINATORICS\n";

    emit_text "  22//7 -> 3\n";
    emit_text "  / never becomes integer division.\n";
    emit_text "  // is floor division, so -7//2 = -4.\n";
    emit_text "  ^ accepts real exponents; e.g. 9^0.5 = 3.\n";

};

// ---------- Identifier scanner ---------------------------------------------

type NameOut {
    NBad;
    NName i64 CharList
};

let lower_ascii = fn (c) {
    case c >= 65 of {
        0 -> c;
        _ -> case c <= 90 of {
            1 -> c + 32;
            _ -> c
        }
    }
};

let is_name_start = fn (c) {
    case c == 95 of {
        1 -> 1;
        _ -> case c >= 65 of {
            0 -> case c >= 97 of {
                0 -> 0;
                _ -> case c <= 122 of {
                    1 -> 1;
                    _ -> 0
                }
            };
            _ -> case c <= 90 of {
                1 -> 1;
                _ -> 0
            }
        }
    }
};

let is_name_char = fn (c) {
    case is_name_start c of {
        1 -> 1;
        _ -> is_digit c
    }
};

// Polynomial hash reduced modulo 1,000,000,007. The calculator's built-in
// names/constants have been checked collision-free under this modulus.
let hash_name = fn (cs acc) {
    case cs of {
        CCons c rest -> case is_name_char c of {
            1 -> hash_name rest (((acc * 131) + lower_ascii c) % 1000000007);
            _ -> NName acc cs
        };
        CNil -> NName acc CNil
    }
};

let parse_name = fn (cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CCons c rest -> case is_name_start c of {
            1 -> hash_name (CCons c rest) 0;
            _ -> NBad
        };
        CNil -> NBad
    }
};

// ---------- Constants ------------------------------------------------------

let const_value = fn (h) {
    case h of {
        14777 -> 3.1415926535897932384626433832795; // pi
        2003500 -> 6.283185307179586476925286766559; // tau
        101 -> 2.7182818284590452353602874713527; // e
        1935761 -> 1.6180339887498948482045868343656; // phi
        621420511 -> 1.6180339887498948482045868343656; // golden
        123496560 -> 1.4142135623730950488016887242097; // sqrt2
        1867848 -> 0.6931471805599453094172321214582; // ln2
        244688005 -> 2.3025850929940456840179914546844; // ln10
        57303579 -> 1.4426950408889634073599246810019; // log2e
        506744797 -> 0.4342944819032518276511289189166; // log10e
        _ -> 0.0
    }
};

let is_constant = fn (h) {
    case h of {
        14777 -> 1; // pi
        2003500 -> 1; // tau
        101 -> 1; // e
        1935761 -> 1; // phi
        621420511 -> 1; // golden
        123496560 -> 1; // sqrt2
        1867848 -> 1; // ln2
        244688005 -> 1; // ln10
        57303579 -> 1; // log2e
        506744797 -> 1; // log10e
        _ -> 0
    }
};

// ---------- Number parser --------------------------------------------------

type NumOut {
    NBad;
    NNum f64 CharList
};

type ExpOut {
    XBad;
    XNum i64 CharList
};

let is_digit = fn (c) {
    case c >= 48 of {
        0 -> 0;
        _ -> case c <= 57 of {
            1 -> 1;
            _ -> 0
        }
    }
};

let digit_value = fn (c) {
    case c of {
        48 -> 0.0;
        49 -> 1.0;
        50 -> 2.0;
        51 -> 3.0;
        52 -> 4.0;
        53 -> 5.0;
        54 -> 6.0;
        55 -> 7.0;
        56 -> 8.0;
        57 -> 9.0;
        _ -> 0.0
    }
};

// Positive integer power of ten, with negative exponent support.
let pow10 = fn (e) {
    case e of {
        0 -> 1.0;
        _ -> case e > 0 of {
            1 -> 10.0 * pow10 (e - 1);
            _ -> 0.1 * pow10 (e + 1)
        }
    }
};

let read_exp_digits = fn (cs acc found) {
    case cs of {
        CCons c rest -> case is_digit c of {
            1 -> read_exp_digits rest ((acc * 10) + (c - 48)) 1;
            _ -> case found of {
                1 -> XNum acc cs;
                _ -> XBad
            }
        };
        CNil -> case found of {
            1 -> XNum acc CNil;
            _ -> XBad
        }
    }
};

let parse_exponent = fn (cs sign) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CCons c rest -> case c of {
            43 -> read_exp_digits rest 0 0;
            45 -> case read_exp_digits rest 0 0 of {
                XBad -> XBad;
                XNum v r -> XNum (0 - v) r
            };
            _ -> case is_digit c of {
                1 -> read_exp_digits (CCons c rest) 0 0;
                _ -> XBad
            }
        };
        CNil -> XBad
    }
};

let read_integer_part = fn (cs acc) {
    case cs of {
        CCons c rest -> case is_digit c of {
            1 -> read_integer_part rest (acc * 10.0 + digit_value c);
            _ -> NNum acc cs
        };
        CNil -> NNum acc CNil
    }
};

let read_fraction2 = fn (cs value place) {
    case cs of {
        CCons c rest -> case is_digit c of {
            1 -> read_fraction2 rest (value + digit_value c * place) (place * 0.1);
            _ -> case c of {
                101 -> case parse_exponent rest 1 of {
                    XBad -> NBad;
                    XNum e r -> NNum (value * pow10 e) r
                };
                69 -> case parse_exponent rest 1 of {
                    XBad -> NBad;
                    XNum e r -> NNum (value * pow10 e) r
                };
                _ -> NNum value cs
            }
        };
        CNil -> NNum value CNil
    }
};

let parse_number = fn (cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CNil -> NBad;
        CCons c rest -> case is_digit c of {
            1 -> case read_integer_part (CCons c rest) 0.0 of {
                NBad -> NBad;
                NNum whole after_int -> case after_int of {
                    CCons 46 after_dot -> read_fraction2 after_dot whole 0.1;
                    CCons ec after_e -> case ec of {
                        101 -> case parse_exponent after_e 1 of {
                            XBad -> NBad;
                            XNum e r -> NNum (whole * pow10 e) r
                        };
                        69 -> case parse_exponent after_e 1 of {
                            XBad -> NBad;
                            XNum e r -> NNum (whole * pow10 e) r
                        };
                        _ -> NNum whole after_int
                    };
                    _ -> NNum whole after_int
                }
            };
            _ -> case c of {
                46 -> case rest of {
                    CCons d _ -> case is_digit d of {
                        1 -> read_fraction2 rest 0.0 0.1;
                        _ -> NBad
                    };
                    _ -> NBad
                };
                _ -> NBad
            }
        }
    }
};

// ---------- Function dispatch -----------------------------------------------

let arity1 = fn (h) {
    case h of {
        1677570 -> 1; // absolute value
        230982852 -> 1; // alias for abs
        260484708 -> 1; // square root
        224257837 -> 1; // cube root
        1749093 -> 1; // e^x
        229131233 -> 1; // 2^x
        16199091 -> 1; // e^x-1
        1868032 -> 1; // natural logarithm
        14258 -> 1; // natural logarithm
        244712242 -> 1; // base-2 logarithm
        57303395 -> 1; // base-10 logarithm
        57303459 -> 1; // ln(1+x)
        1987380 -> 1; // sine
        1713595 -> 1; // cosine
        2003493 -> 1; // tangent
        220052207 -> 1; // inverse sine
        219778422 -> 1; // inverse cosine
        220068320 -> 1; // inverse tangent
        260346884 -> 1; // hyperbolic sine
        224481049 -> 1; // hyperbolic cosine
        262457687 -> 1; // hyperbolic tangent
        224547597 -> 1; // hyperbolic cosecant
        260276799 -> 1; // hyperbolic secant
        224481180 -> 1; // hyperbolic cotangent
        826839025 -> 1; // inverse sinh
        790973190 -> 1; // inverse cosh
        828949828 -> 1; // inverse tanh
        1713596 -> 1; // cotangent
        1986845 -> 1; // secant
        1714103 -> 1; // cosecant
        219778423 -> 1; // inverse cotangent
        220051672 -> 1; // inverse secant
        219778930 -> 1; // inverse cosecant
        283705086 -> 1; // floor
        224308133 -> 1; // ceiling
        420295318 -> 1; // truncate toward zero
        824551211 -> 1; // nearest integer-valued double
        354247632 -> 1; // factorial / Gamma(x+1)

        553441405 -> 1; // Gamma function

        1748297 -> 1; // error function
        229027006 -> 1; // complementary error function
        244712290 -> 1; // binary exponent

        1729434 -> 1; // radians to degrees
        1969161 -> 1; // degrees to radians
        992605559 -> 1; // degrees to radians
        430838469 -> 1; // radians to degrees
        184475947 -> 1; // x^2
        224581785 -> 1; // x^3
        _ -> 0
    }
};

let arity2 = fn (h) {
    case h of {
        828949774 -> 1; // quadrant-aware atan
        231190472 -> 1; // floating remainder
        1885190 -> 1; // mod alias
        1969694 -> 1; // rem alias
        510764621 -> 1; // IEEE-style remainder
        1936692 -> 1; // x^y
        258201902 -> 1; // nth root
        548941060 -> 1; // alias for root
        901947274 -> 1; // sqrt(x^2+y^2)
        1780652 -> 1; // greatest common divisor
        1866466 -> 1; // least common multiple
        1900793 -> 1; // binomial coefficient
        224480257 -> 1; // alias for ncr
        1902496 -> 1; // permutations
        253534496 -> 1; // alias for npr
        1884414 -> 1; // minimum
        1883376 -> 1; // maximum
        262106026 -> 1; // magnitude of a with sign of b
        231035246 -> 1; // positive difference
        231188658 -> 1; // floating maximum
        231189696 -> 1; // floating minimum
        743972013 -> 1; // next representable double
        _ -> 0
    }
};

let arity3 = fn (h) {
    case h of {
        399964812 -> 1; // clamp x into [lo,hi]
        1764798 -> 1; // fused multiply-add
        _ -> 0
    }
};

// ---------- Numeric functions ----------------------------------------------

let unary_call = fn (h x) {
    case h of {
        1677570 -> fabs_c x; // abs
        230982852 -> fabs_c x; // fabs
        260484708 -> sqrt_c x; // sqrt
        224257837 -> cbrt_c x; // cbrt
        1749093 -> exp_c x; // exp
        229131233 -> exp2_c x; // exp2
        16199091 -> expm1_c x; // expm1
        1868032 -> log_c x; // log
        14258 -> log_c x; // ln
        244712242 -> log2_c x; // log2
        57303395 -> log10_c x; // log10
        57303459 -> log1p_c x; // log1p
        1987380 -> sin_c x; // sin
        1713595 -> cos_c x; // cos
        2003493 -> tan_c x; // tan
        220052207 -> asin_c x; // asin
        219778422 -> acos_c x; // acos
        220068320 -> atan_c x; // atan
        260346884 -> sinh_c x; // sinh
        224481049 -> cosh_c x; // cosh
        262457687 -> tanh_c x; // tanh
        224547597 -> 1.0 / sinh_c x; // csch
        260276799 -> 1.0 / cosh_c x; // sech
        224481180 -> cosh_c x / sinh_c x; // coth
        826839025 -> asinh_c x; // asinh
        790973190 -> acosh_c x; // acosh
        828949828 -> atanh_c x; // atanh
        1713596 -> cos_c x / sin_c x; // cot
        1986845 -> 1.0 / cos_c x; // sec
        1714103 -> 1.0 / sin_c x; // csc
        219778423 -> 1.57079632679489661923 - atan_c x; // acot
        220051672 -> acos_c (1.0 / x); // asec
        219778930 -> asin_c (1.0 / x); // acsc
        283705086 -> floor_c x; // floor
        224308133 -> ceil_c x; // ceil
        420295318 -> trunc_c x; // trunc
        824551211 -> round_c x; // round
        354247632 -> tgamma_c (x + 1.0); // factorial
        230982984 -> tgamma_c (x + 1.0); // fact
        553441405 -> tgamma_c x; // gamma
        138294544 -> lgamma_c x; // lgamma
        1748297 -> erf_c x; // erf
        229027006 -> erfc_c x; // erfc
        244712290 -> logb_c x; // logb
        260345973 -> case x > 0.0 of { 1 -> 1.0; _ -> case x < 0.0 of { 1 -> -1.0; _ -> 0.0 } }; // sign
        231274442 -> x - trunc_c x; // frac
        1729434 -> x * 57.2957795130823208768; // deg
        1969161 -> x * 0.0174532925199432957692; // rad
        992605559 -> x * 0.0174532925199432957692; // radians
        430838469 -> x * 57.2957795130823208768; // degrees
        184475947 -> x * x; // square
        224581785 -> x * x * x; // cube
        _ -> 0.0
    }
};

let binary_call = fn (h a b) {
    case h of {
        828949774 -> atan2_c a b; // atan2
        231190472 -> fmod_c a b; // fmod
        1885190 -> fmod_c a b; // mod
        1969694 -> fmod_c a b; // rem
        510764621 -> remainder_c a b; // remainder
        1936692 -> pow_c a b; // pow
        258201902 -> pow_c a (1.0 / b); // root
        548941060 -> pow_c a (1.0 / b); // nthroot
        901947274 -> hypot_c a b; // hypot
        1780652 -> { let aa = fabs_c a; let bb = fabs_c b; case bb == 0.0 of { 1 -> aa; _ -> binary_call 1780652 bb (fmod_c aa bb) } }; // gcd
        1866466 -> { let g = binary_call 1780652 a b; case g == 0.0 of { 1 -> 0.0; _ -> fabs_c (a * b) / g } }; // lcm
        1900793 -> { let nn = round_c a; let rr = round_c b; case rr < 0.0 of { 1 -> 0.0; _ -> case rr > nn of { 1 -> 0.0; _ -> round_c (exp_c (lgamma_c (nn + 1.0) - lgamma_c (rr + 1.0) - lgamma_c (nn - rr + 1.0))) } } }; // ncr
        224480257 -> binary_call 1900793 a b; // comb
        1902496 -> { let nn = round_c a; let rr = round_c b; case rr < 0.0 of { 1 -> 0.0; _ -> case rr > nn of { 1 -> 0.0; _ -> round_c (exp_c (lgamma_c (nn + 1.0) - lgamma_c (nn - rr + 1.0))) } } }; // npr
        253534496 -> binary_call 1902496 a b; // perm
        1884414 -> case a < b of { 1 -> a; _ -> b }; // min
        1883376 -> case a > b of { 1 -> a; _ -> b }; // max
        262106026 -> copysign_c a b; // copysign
        231035246 -> fdim_c a b; // fdim
        231188658 -> fmax_c a b; // fmax
        231189696 -> fmin_c a b; // fmin
        743972013 -> nextafter_c a b; // nextafter
        _ -> 0.0
    }
};

let ternary_call = fn (h x a b) {
    case h of {
        399964812 -> case x < a of {
            1 -> a;
            _ -> case x > b of {
                1 -> b;
                _ -> x
            }
        };
        1764798 -> fma_c x a b;
        _ -> x
    }
};

// ---------- Expression parser ----------------------------------------------
//
// expr   := term (('+'|'-') term)*
// term   := power (('*'|'/'|'//'|'%') power)*
// power  := unary ('^' unary)?
// unary  := ('+'|'-') unary | postfix
// postfix:= atom ('!' | '%' postfix-at-end)*
// atom   := number | identifier | identifier '(' args ')' | '(' expr ')'
//
// `//` is checked before `/`.
// `%` is postfix only when it is followed by an expression delimiter/end;
// otherwise it is binary remainder.
// Function application with parentheses keeps scientific-calculator syntax simple:
//   sin(pi/2), pow(2,10), ncr(52,5)

type ExprOut {
    EOK f64 CharList;
    EBad
};

let parse_call1 = fn (h cs) {
    case parse_expr cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK a rest -> case skip_space rest of {
            CCons 41 rest2 -> case arity1 h of {
                1 -> EOK (unary_call h a) rest2;
                _ -> EBad
            };
            _ -> EBad
        }
    }
};

let parse_call2 = fn (h cs) {
    case parse_expr cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK a r1 -> case skip_space r1 of {
            CCons 44 r2 -> case parse_expr r2 of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK b r3 -> case skip_space r3 of {
                    CCons 41 r4 -> case arity2 h of {
                        1 -> EOK (binary_call h a b) r4;
                        _ -> EBad
                    };
                    _ -> EBad
                }
            };
            _ -> EBad
        }
    }
};

let parse_call3 = fn (h cs) {
    case parse_expr cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK a r1 -> case skip_space r1 of {
            CCons 44 r2 -> case parse_expr r2 of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK b r3 -> case skip_space r3 of {
                    CCons 44 r4 -> case parse_expr r4 of {
                        EBad -> EBad;
                        EOK c r5 -> case skip_space r5 of {
                            CCons 41 r6 -> case arity3 h of {
                                1 -> EOK (ternary_call h a b c) r6;
                                _ -> EBad
                            };
                            _ -> EBad
                        }
                    };
                    _ -> EBad
                }
            };
            _ -> EBad
        }
    }
};

let parse_named = fn (h cs) {
    case arity3 h of {
        1 -> parse_call3 h cs;
        _ -> case arity2 h of {
            1 -> parse_call2 h cs;
            _ -> case arity1 h of {
                1 -> parse_call1 h cs;
                _ -> EBad
            }
        }
    }
};

let parse_atom = fn (cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CNil -> EBad;
        CCons c rest -> case c of {
            40 -> case parse_expr rest of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK v r -> case skip_space r of {
                    CCons 41 r2 -> EOK v r2;
                    _ -> EBad
                }
            };
            _ -> case is_name_start c of {
                1 -> case parse_name (CCons c rest) of {
                    NBad -> EBad;
                    NName h r -> case skip_space r of {
                        CCons 40 r2 -> parse_named h r2;
                        _ -> case is_constant h of {
                            1 -> EOK (const_value h) r;
                            _ -> EBad
                        }
                    }
                };
                _ -> case parse_number cs of {
                    NBad -> EBad;
                    NNum v r -> EOK v r
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

let parse_postfix_loop = fn (value cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CCons 33 rest -> parse_postfix_loop (tgamma_c (value + 1.0)) rest;
        CCons 37 rest -> case skip_space rest of {
            CNil -> EOK (value / 100.0) CNil;
            CCons c _ -> case c of {
                41 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                44 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                43 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                45 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                42 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                47 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                94 -> EOK (value / 100.0) rest;
                _ -> EOK value cs
            }
        };
        _ -> EOK value cs
    }
};

let parse_postfix = fn (cs) {
    case parse_atom cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK value rest -> parse_postfix_loop value rest
    }
};

let parse_power = fn (cs) {
    case parse_postfix cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK left rest -> case skip_space rest of {
            CCons 94 r2 -> case parse_unary r2 of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK exponent r3 -> EOK (pow_c left exponent) r3
            };
            _ -> EOK left rest
        }
    }
};

let parse_unary = fn (cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CNil -> EBad;
        CCons c rest -> case c of {
            43 -> parse_unary rest;
            45 -> case parse_unary rest of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK v r -> EOK (0.0 - v) r
            };
            _ -> parse_power cs
        }
    }
};

let parse_term_loop = fn (left cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CNil -> EOK left CNil;
        CCons c rest -> case c of {
            42 -> case parse_power rest of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK rhs r2 -> parse_term_loop (left * rhs) r2
            };
            47 -> case rest of {
                CCons 47 rest2 -> case parse_power rest2 of {
                    EBad -> EBad;
                    EOK rhs r2 -> case rhs == 0.0 of {
                        1 -> EBad;
                        _ -> parse_term_loop (floor_c (left / rhs)) r2
                    }
                };
                _ -> case parse_power rest of {
                    EBad -> EBad;
                    EOK rhs r2 -> case rhs == 0.0 of {
                        1 -> EBad;
                        _ -> parse_term_loop (left / rhs) r2
                    }
                }
            };
            37 -> case parse_power rest of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK rhs r2 -> case rhs == 0.0 of {
                    1 -> EBad;
                    _ -> parse_term_loop (fmod_c left rhs) r2
                }
            };
            _ -> case is_name_start c of {
                1 -> case parse_power cs of {
                    EBad -> EOK left cs;
                    EOK rhs r2 -> parse_term_loop (left * rhs) r2
                };
                _ -> case is_digit c of {
                    1 -> case parse_power cs of {
                        EBad -> EOK left cs;
                        EOK rhs r2 -> parse_term_loop (left * rhs) r2
                    };
                    _ -> case c of {
                        46 -> case parse_power cs of {
                            EBad -> EOK left cs;
                            EOK rhs r2 -> parse_term_loop (left * rhs) r2
                        };
                        40 -> case parse_power cs of {
                            EBad -> EOK left cs;
                            EOK rhs r2 -> parse_term_loop (left * rhs) r2
                        };
                        _ -> EOK left cs
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

let parse_term = fn (cs) {
    case parse_power cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK left rest -> parse_term_loop left rest
    }
};

let parse_expr_loop = fn (left cs) {
    case skip_space cs of {
        CNil -> EOK left CNil;
        CCons c rest -> case c of {
            43 -> case parse_term rest of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK rhs r2 -> parse_expr_loop (left + rhs) r2
            };
            45 -> case parse_term rest of {
                EBad -> EBad;
                EOK rhs r2 -> parse_expr_loop (left - rhs) r2
            };
            _ -> EOK left cs
        }
    }
};

let parse_expr = fn (cs) {
    case parse_term cs of {
        EBad -> EBad;
        EOK left rest -> parse_expr_loop left rest
    }
};

let evaluate_line = fn (cs) {
    case parse_expr cs of {
        EBad -> emit_text "Error: invalid expression\n";
        EOK value rest -> case skip_space rest of {
            CNil -> print_f64 value;
            _ -> emit_text "Error: unexpected characters\n"
        }
    }
};

// ---------- REPL -----------------------------------------------------------

let repl = fn () {
    emit_text ">>> ";
    case read_line () of {
        LEof -> emit_char 10;
        LLine cs -> case is_exit cs of {
            1 -> emit_char 10;
            _ -> case is_help cs of {
                1 -> {
                    print_help ();
                    repl ()
                };
                _ -> {
                    evaluate_line cs;
                    repl ()
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

let calculator_main = fn () {
    emit_text "MAK Scientific Calculator\n";
    emit_text "Real /, floor //, remainder %, power ^, factorial !\n";
    emit_text "Type help for the complete scientific function list.\n";
    emit_text "Example: 22/7 = 3.1428571428571428...\n\n";
    repl ()
};

calculator_main ()

static inline void *mak_ir_heap_alloc(size_t size, size_t align) {
    if (size == 0) size = 1;
    if (align == 0) align = _Alignof(max_align_t);
    if ((align & (align - 1)) != 0 || align > MAK_ARENA_MAX_ALIGN) return NULL;
    const size_t base = sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr) + sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link);
    if (align - 1 > SIZE_MAX - base) return NULL;
    const size_t pre = base + (align - 1);
    if (size > SIZE_MAX - pre) return NULL;
    const size_t no_tail = pre + size;
    if (sizeof(uint64_t) > SIZE_MAX - no_tail) return NULL;
    const size_t total = no_tail + sizeof(uint64_t);
    unsigned char *raw = (unsigned char *)malloc(total);
    if (!raw) return NULL;
    const uintptr_t r = (uintptr_t)(void *)raw;
    if (r > UINTPTR_MAX - base) { free(raw); return NULL; }
    const uintptr_t q = r + base;
    const uintptr_t mask = (uintptr_t)align - 1u;
    if (q > UINTPTR_MAX - mask) { free(raw); return NULL; }
    const uintptr_t payload_addr = (q + mask) & ~mask;
    if (payload_addr < r) { free(raw); return NULL; }
    const size_t off = (size_t)(payload_addr - r);
    if (off > total || size > total - off || sizeof(uint64_t) > total - off - size) { free(raw); return NULL; }

    memset(h, 0, sizeof(*h));
    h->magic = MAK_IR_HEAP_MAGIC; h->total = total; h->payload_off = off; h->size = size; h->alignment = align; h->cookie = mak_ir_heap_cookie(h);
    struct mak_ir_heap_link *ln = (struct mak_ir_heap_link *)(void *)(payload_addr - sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link));
    ln->magic = MAK_IR_HEAP_LINK_MAGIC; ln->hdr = h;
    const uint64_t tail_value = MAK_IR_HEAP_TAIL ^ (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h ^ (uint64_t)size;

static inline void mak_ir_heap_free(void *ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    const uintptr_t pa = (uintptr_t)ptr;
    if (pa < sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link)) { mak_ir_heap_fault("invalid heap pointer"); return; }
    struct mak_ir_heap_link *ln = (struct mak_ir_heap_link *)(void *)(pa - sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link));

    if (h->magic != MAK_IR_HEAP_MAGIC || h->cookie != mak_ir_heap_cookie(h)) { mak_ir_heap_fault("invalid heap header"); return; }
    if (h->total < sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr) + sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link) + sizeof(uint64_t) || h->payload_off < sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_hdr) + sizeof(struct mak_ir_heap_link) || h->payload_off > h->total || h->size > h->total - h->payload_off || sizeof(uint64_t) > h->total - h->payload_off - h->size) { mak_ir_heap_fault("invalid heap bounds"); return; }
